notes.subject: Kristy call notes — 2026 outreach
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten notes list Madison County Fair in Rexburg, 208-242-8901, with a June 3 message. Gmail confirms separate outreach to the Rexburg, Idaho fair. Keep this distinct from the booked Madison County Fair in Twin Bridges, Montana. Source: handwritten call notes, page 87; Adventure Zone Gmail.
